name: CHAMPREP Mail
author: champrep

sections.description:
CHAMPREP Mail is the official WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for CHAMPREP Mail—a complete business email, internal team email, and custom domain email platform built for growing companies, agencies, and online stores.

Connect your WordPress site to CHAMPREP Mail to read and reply to business emails right inside your WordPress dashboard, manage custom sending domains and multiple domains, verify DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and send WooCommerce store emails reliably from your own branded domain—without wrestling with fragile WordPress SMTP plugins or juggling disconnected webmail tabs.

Why CHAMPREP Mail Is the Best Business Email Solution for WordPress

Most WordPress email plugins only solve half the problem: either they act as a basic SMTP relay with no inbox, or they force your team into a separate consumer email tool that knows nothing about your site or customers. CHAMPREP Mail unifies professional business email hosting, internal email for teams, and WordPress & WooCommerce email delivery in one secure platform:

  • Email on your own domain (and multiple domains): Send and receive professional email from addresses like hello@yourcompany.com, support@yourbrand.com, or orders@yourstore.com—and manage multiple domains under a single CHAMPREP workspace for multi-brand businesses, agencies, and holding companies.
  • Shared mailboxes for internal team email: Keep sales, support, billing, and operations aligned with shared mailboxes (support@, info@, orders@, sales@) so your team never misses a customer message or duplicates replies.
  • Built-in AI email assistant: Draft faster replies, summarize long email threads, polish tone for business communication, and triage busy inboxes with the CHAMPREP Mail AI assistant in your connected CHAMPREP workspace.
  • Modern alternative to traditional WordPress SMTP: Deliver authenticated WooCommerce transactional emails through the CHAMPREP Mail API over HTTPS with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE security—no plaintext SMTP passwords stored in wp-config.php or the WordPress database. Need SMTP for external apps or legacy WordPress workflows? Your CHAMPREP Mail plan also supports standards-based business email access alongside the API.
  • Inbox directly inside WordPress: View authorized mailboxes, switch folders, read full conversations, compose messages, and send attachments from Settings > CHAMPREP Mail without leaving wp-admin.
  • Higher email deliverability with guided DNS verification: Add sending domains and trigger DNS verification checks (SPF, DKIM, and DMARC alignment) straight from WordPress so your business and order emails land in the inbox instead of spam.

WooCommerce Store Emails & Order Context (Optional)

With WooCommerce active, CHAMPREP Mail turns your store’s transactional email into a connected customer communication hub:

  • Branded WooCommerce order emails: Send order confirmations, processing and completed order notices, refunds, customer notes, invoices, new-account emails, password resets, and store new-order alerts from a verified mailbox on your own CHAMPREP Mail domain.
  • Granular opt-in control: You choose the sender mailbox and pick exactly which WooCommerce emails go through CHAMPREP; nothing changes until you turn it on.
  • Sent-folder visibility and reply continuity: Every WooCommerce email sent through CHAMPREP is saved in that mailbox’s Sent folder, customer replies arrive in the same mailbox, and an order note is added automatically.
  • Automatic fallback for zero lost emails: If CHAMPREP cannot accept an email (for example, a domain is not yet verified, a plan limit is reached, or the service is temporarily unreachable), WordPress sends it with its usual mailer immediately so customers always receive their email.
  • Order and customer context side by side: On every WooCommerce order screen, the CHAMPREP Mail panel lists the store emails sent for that order and lets you email the customer directly from your store mailbox. Inside the plugin’s WordPress inbox, the sender’s WooCommerce orders (order number, status, total, and date) appear right beside the conversation.
  • Modern WooCommerce ready: Fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart and Checkout blocks.

Full Business Email Platform at mail.champrep.com

Your connected CHAMPREP Mail account extends beyond WordPress with a complete suite of enterprise-ready business email features available on web, desktop, and mobile:

  • Multiple custom domains and unlimited domain routing rules under one organization
  • Shared mailboxes and internal team email collaboration
  • AI email assistant for smart drafting, thread summaries, and faster business replies
  • Authenticated business email delivery (API and SMTP access governed by your CHAMPREP Mail plan)
  • Unified CHAMPREP ecosystem integrating seamlessly with Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Chat, Meetings, and Work

Works With or Without WooCommerce

The plugin works without WooCommerce: the WordPress inbox, compose with attachments, custom domain management, and DNS verification features do not require WooCommerce. It does not change WordPress’s own system emails (only WooCommerce’s emails, when you turn that on), and it does not send marketing or bulk email.

External services

This plugin connects to CHAMPREP LLC’s CHAMPREP Auth and Mail services. CHAMPREP Auth registers the OAuth client, signs the site administrator into CHAMPREP, and issues or refreshes the delegated authorization. CHAMPREP Mail provides the mailbox, message, sending-domain, DNS-verification, and test-delivery functions. These services are required for the plugin to work.

When an administrator connects the plugin, WordPress sends the integration name, site callback URL, redirect URL, and plugin software/version metadata to CHAMPREP Auth to register the OAuth client. During sign-in, the authorization code and PKCE proof are exchanged for delegated tokens. The plugin stores the client ID and encrypted access and refresh tokens in the site’s WordPress options; message bodies and attachments are not stored as WordPress options by this plugin.

When an administrator views or uses a Mail feature, the plugin sends the delegated access token and the requested mailbox, folder, conversation, domain, or message data to the CHAMPREP Mail API. Reading a conversation transfers its message content to the WordPress server for display. Sending a message transfers the selected sender, recipient, subject, body, and any selected attachments to the Mail API. Domain actions transfer the domain name or domain identifier. Apart from WooCommerce store emails and connection upkeep, requests occur only in response to an administrator opening or using the corresponding feature.

When WooCommerce store emails are turned on, each selected WooCommerce email is sent to the CHAMPREP Mail API at the moment WooCommerce sends it (for example when a customer places an order). The request carries the sender mailbox, the recipient addresses, the subject, the email content (which includes order details and the customer’s name, billing and shipping addresses as WooCommerce writes them) and any attachments WooCommerce adds. CHAMPREP Mail delivers the email and keeps a copy in the store’s mailbox. While connected, the plugin also renews its CHAMPREP authorization about once an hour with CHAMPREP Auth (no store data is sent), so store emails keep working when no administrator is signed in. The plugin adds suggested text for this to the site’s privacy policy guide.

The plugin does not add analytics or advertising tracking.

CHAMPREP’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy describe the service and its handling of information.

Security and data

OAuth authorization uses state and PKCE S256. Tokens are encrypted in WordPress options with AES-256-GCM using WordPress auth salts. The Mail API remains authoritative for account access, domain verification, service entitlements, quotas, and sending policy.

Reconnect once a month: CHAMPREP asks for a fresh approval 30 days after you connect. Five days before, administrators see a one-click Reconnect button. Until you reconnect, WooCommerce emails are sent by WordPress’s usual mailer.

For a full disconnect, revoke the CHAMPREP Mail connection under your CHAMPREP account’s connected-app security settings, then disconnect the local plugin. The plugin does not have permission to revoke its own OAuth grant.

Limitations

The embedded WordPress client currently provides mailbox and folder selection, thread list and reading, text composition, attachments on outgoing messages, domain status, DNS verification requests, WooCommerce store email routing, and test delivery. Advanced search, routing of WordPress core system emails, campaigns, AI assistant workflows, and shared-mailbox ticket automation are available in full CHAMPREP Mail at https://mail.champrep.com.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the CHAMPREP Mail plugin from your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Settings > CHAMPREP Mail and connect the CHAMPREP account that owns your CHAMPREP Mail subscription.
  3. Add one or more custom sending domains and request DNS verification (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) directly from CHAMPREP Mail.
  4. Browse mailboxes, read conversations, and compose business emails with attachments from Settings > CHAMPREP Mail. Use the full CHAMPREP Mail web and mobile apps at mail.champrep.com for shared-mailbox management, AI assistant workflows, and advanced search.
  5. WooCommerce stores: Go to Settings > CHAMPREP Mail > WooCommerce store emails, choose your verified sender mailbox, select the store emails you want to route, and turn sending on.
sections.faq:
Do I need a CHAMPREP account?

Yes. The plugin connects to the CHAMPREP account that holds your CHAMPREP Mail plan. CHAMPREP enforces its plan, sending limits, and domain verification.

Can I use my own custom domain and manage multiple domains?

Yes. CHAMPREP Mail is built for business email on your own custom domain, and supports managing multiple domains within your CHAMPREP Mail workspace. You can check domain status and request DNS verification right from the WordPress plugin.

Does CHAMPREP Mail support shared mailboxes and an AI assistant?

Yes. Shared mailboxes for internal team email (support@, sales@, orders@) and the CHAMPREP Mail AI email assistant are core features of your connected CHAMPREP Mail platform at mail.champrep.com. From WordPress, you can access authorized mailboxes, read threads, reply with attachments, and send WooCommerce store emails from your chosen business mailbox.

Is CHAMPREP Mail a replacement for WordPress SMTP plugins?

For WooCommerce store emails, yes—CHAMPREP Mail delivers your selected store emails over an authenticated HTTPS API using OAuth 2.1 + PKCE rather than storing plaintext SMTP credentials in WordPress. Every message is logged in your mailbox’s Sent folder with automatic fallback to WordPress’s default mailer if delivery cannot be accepted.

Which WooCommerce emails can go through CHAMPREP Mail?

Any email WooCommerce sends through its mailer: new, processing, completed, refunded, and failed orders, customer notes, invoices, new-account and password-reset emails, and emails added by other WooCommerce extensions that use the WooCommerce mailer. You pick them one by one under Settings > CHAMPREP Mail > WooCommerce store emails.

What happens if CHAMPREP cannot send an email?

WordPress sends it with its usual mailer straight away, the order gets a note saying so, and administrators see a warning. Customers always receive their email.

Where do customer replies go?

To the sender mailbox you chose on your custom domain. Read and answer them in Settings > CHAMPREP Mail—where the customer’s WooCommerce orders are shown next to the conversation—or in CHAMPREP Mail on the web and mobile apps.

Why do I need to reconnect every month?

For security, CHAMPREP approves a connected site for 30 days at a time. Five days before that ends, WordPress shows a “Reconnect” button on every admin page; one click and a CHAMPREP sign-in renews it, and your settings stay as they are. If the approval ends anyway, WooCommerce emails keep going out through WordPress’s usual mailer until you reconnect.

Does it change WordPress’s own emails?

No. Only WooCommerce’s emails are affected, and only the ones you select.

Does it work with High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage and the Cart and Checkout blocks, and stores its order data through WooCommerce’s order APIs.
sections.changelog:
0.4.1

  • Docs: expanded WordPress.org directory listing, FAQ, and feature overview covering business email, custom and multiple domains, shared mailboxes, AI email assistant, and WooCommerce store email delivery.

0.4.0

  • New: send WooCommerce store emails from your CHAMPREP Mail mailbox, with automatic fallback to WordPress’s mailer, order notes and a recent-activity log.
  • New: CHAMPREP Mail panel on WooCommerce orders to see the order’s emails and email the customer.
  • New: the customer’s WooCommerce orders are shown next to their conversations in the inbox.
  • Keeps the CHAMPREP connection active for unattended store emails, and warns before the approval needs renewing.
  • Declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and the Cart and Checkout blocks.

0.3.1

  • First WordPress.org release: inbox, compose with attachments, sending domains and DNS verification.
